people.name: Mika
observations: Picked Jordan up before the open mic so Jordan couldn't bail
Hit it off immediately with Dev, discussing an obscure documentary about Nigerian funk music
Yelled something supportive and embarrassing when Jordan finished performing
Kept saying "I TOLD you" with a triumphant look
Stayed for two more hours after the performance

people.name: Dev
observations: Was already at The Lantern sitting near the front with a beer when Jordan and Mika arrived
Hit it off immediately with Mika, discussing an obscure documentary about Nigerian funk music
Bought Jordan a celebratory drink after the performance
Stayed for two more hours after the performance

places.name: The Lantern
observations: Hosted an open mic night on 8/21
Jordan performed sixth, playing guitar and singing "Fast Car"
A woman played ukulele and sang an original song that made Jordan tear up
A guy did a 9-minute spoken word piece about his electric bill
Jordan and friends stayed for two more hours after Jordan's performance
